## Where This Lives in UpstreamDrift {#sec-upstream-implementation-gom-vol0-ch11}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The Lagrangian power-check example here stays in AffineDrift (`src/tools/lagrangian_examples.py`). For the same rigid-body inertias and bias forces inside UpstreamDrift's humanoid/club models, consult commit [`27b6eead`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/commit/27b6eeadbbd970bebb8926a3c83aeaea1f6ee4da).

- **Spatial inertia primitives:** [`inertia.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/27b6eeadbbd970bebb8926a3c83aeaea1f6ee4da/src/shared/python/spatial_algebra/inertia.py) — kinetic-energy and composite-inertia building blocks.
- **Inverse dynamics cross-check:** [`rnea.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/27b6eeadbbd970bebb8926a3c83aeaea1f6ee4da/src/engines/physics_engines/mujoco/python/mujoco_humanoid_golf/rigid_body_dynamics/rnea.py) — compare $M\ddot q + h$ against an independent RNEA pass on the same model state.

**Convention note:** the textbook's relative-angle motor map is didactic; production models declare their own generalized coordinates in each URDF/MJCF asset.
:::
